description: Enchanting extras: enchantment pages (Sharpness, Mending; the sword list is ordered Fire Aspect, Knockback, Looting, Sweeping Edge, Bane of Arthropods, Sharpness, Smite, Mending, Unbreaking, Vanishing) and the Item Info screen of a plain enchantable item with its list of enchantments. The second page of an enchantment (Where to Find) is reached with the page buttons of the recipe; the Item Info page of an enchanted book needs a stack with components, which emi_stack_key cannot create: hover a book and press the Item Info key.
